items.q: Joe Turner on the piano... I should know him but - but these are the only two people impressed me in the .

ctx.x: mistake in my life, as I tried to tell you, is when Adelaide Hall came to Omaha, Nebraska; Joe Turner on the piano; Art Tatum on the piano. She had three pianists. You must remember in these areas the only way a black person beside Dan and Eddie which were European that worked - they were two black men that worked in tuxedos - when you played the RKO or the Keith's circuit or the Pantages circuit, you had to put on a bandanna, you see. There had to be a cotton scene. But these people came over with class. Here's…
